model: Go Go Elite Traveller 3-Wheel (SC40E; SC44E is the 4-wheel version)
notes: Small travel scooter. Battery packs differ by market and year.

gaps: The 2012 manual does not print a model number.

Charger current conflicts between Pride documents: the order form and the Canadian spec sheet (ca_gogoelite_ss_e.pdf) say a 3.5-amp off-board charger, while the US brochure, the UK spec sheet and Pride's Elite Traveller specifications sheet (INFINFB3208 Rev A, July 2013, models 40E/44E) say off-b...
The controller maker is not named.
The retailer's spec table labels the 45 A rating as '45 AH', which conflicts.
Other retailer listings could not be opened and are not used.
None of the Pride documents read give a breaker rating or motor wattage.
method: Three Pride documents from pridemobility.com were read as text: the US spec sheet/brochure (code 100824), the current US quick-ship order form (INFINFB3743 Rev L, 20 Mar 2026) and the Elite Traveller owner's manual (INFMANU3107 Rev I, February 2012).
The brochure and order form tie the name to SC40E.

Pride's current SC40E product page links a newer Travel Scooter Series owner's manual (INFMANU4392 Rev R, January 2026), which lists model 40E and describes the same battery-pack main circuit breaker, battery pack fuse and tiller console fuse (the last 'if equipped').
The order form figure is used.
The manual says to use only AGM or gel-cell batteries, two 12-volt sealed deep-cycle.
Braking per the manual is regenerative, with a disc park brake.
The motor brushes are inside the motor/transaxle assembly, and the axle bearings and transaxle are sealed and prelubricated.
Pride's brochure and UK and Canadian spec sheets call the controller microprocessor-based.
A retailer (Mobility Scooters Direct) sells a 45 A Curtis controller as an OEM replacement for SC40E/SC44E and says serial numbers are needed to confirm fit.

comps.spec: 12Ah battery box, part BATASMB1028, with two 12Ah batteries (standard); optional 18Ah battery box BATASMB1029 with two 18Ah batteries
24-volt DC motor on a sealed mini-transaxle
Motor/transaxle assembly, electromechanical, sealed and prelubricated; motor brushes are housed inside it
comps.loc: Rear section, with the manual freewheel lever and anti-tip wheels

comps.spec: Disc park brake that applies once regenerative braking has nearly stopped the scooter, or whenever power is removed; released with the drive system by the manual freewheel lever
Main circuit breaker with push-in reset button; trips on low battery voltage or heavy load to protect the motor and electronics
3-amp tiller console fuse, protects the tiller console electronics
Battery pack fuse, the one to check when the batteries will not charge
Curtis controller, 45 amp, sold as an OEM replacement for SC40E/SC44E, SKU CTL2107580; serial number needed to confirm fit
